headline: RU Hall Provost withdrawn after attack on journalists; probe report due in 72 hours
summary: The decision came after a meeting with student activists and journalists, who had protested the university's initial case filing against unidentified individuals.
details: The Provost of Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall at Rajshahi University (RU) has been withdrawn due to alleged negligence following an attack on journalists. A committee has been instructed to submit an investigation report within 72 hours.
University Vice-Chancellor announced this decision late Tuesday night, after a meeting with student activists and journalists. The meeting addressed the incident and the subsequent demands.

Earlier, journalists and students protested in front of the administrative building against the university's decision to file a case against unnamed individuals regarding the attack. They gathered on Monday evening, chanting slogans against the administration and Chhatra Dal.
The protestors later met with the Vice-Chancellor at 11 PM. Following assurances from the VC, students announced a temporary withdrawal of their movement until Thursday evening.
caption:
Rajshahi University's Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall Provost has been withdrawn following an attack on journalists. An investigation report is expected within 72 hours.

The Provost of Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Hall at Rajshahi University (RU) has been withdrawn due to alleged negligence following an attack on journalists. A committee has been instructed to submit an investigation report within 72 hours.

University Vice-Chancellor announced this decision late Tuesday night, after a meeting with student activists and journalists. The meeting addressed the incident and the subsequent demands.

Earlier, journalists and students protested in front of the administrative building against the university's decision to file a case against unnamed individuals regarding the attack. They gathered on Monday evening, chanting slogans against the administration and Chhatra Dal.

The protestors later met with the Vice-Chancellor at 11 PM. Following assurances from the VC, students announced a temporary withdrawal of their movement until Thursday evening.

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star

headline: UN Secretary-General to visit Pakistan for US-Iran mediation talks
summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres is set to arrive in Islamabad this week to discuss Pakistan's diplomatic efforts in mediating between the United States and Iran. He will meet with senior Pakistani officials.
details: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres is scheduled to visit Pakistan this week. The purpose of his trip is to discuss mediation efforts between the United States and Iran, according to Al Jazeera.
Guterres is expected to arrive in Pakistan's capital, Islamabad, on Tuesday, October 6. During his stay, he will engage in discussions regarding the country's diplomatic and mediation initiatives.

A UN statement highlighted that the visit would provide an opportunity to discuss Islamabad's constructive role in facilitating dialogue between the two nations. This underscores the importance of regional diplomatic engagement.
The Secretary-General's itinerary includes meetings with senior Pakistani government officials. These include Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Foreign Minister Mohammad Ishaq Dar.
Guterres' last visit to Pakistan was in 2022, when he traveled to the country to assess the devastating flood situation.
caption:
UN Secretary-General António Guterres is heading to Pakistan this week for crucial talks. His mission: to discuss mediation efforts between the United States and Iran.

United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres is scheduled to visit Pakistan this week. The purpose of his trip is to discuss mediation efforts between the United States and Iran, according to Al Jazeera.

Guterres is expected to arrive in Pakistan's capital, Islamabad, on Tuesday, October 6. During his stay, he will engage in discussions regarding the country's diplomatic and mediation initiatives.

A UN statement highlighted that the visit would provide an opportunity to discuss Islamabad's constructive role in facilitating dialogue between the two nations. This underscores the importance of regional diplomatic engagement.

The Secretary-General's itinerary includes meetings with senior Pakistani government officials. These include Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Foreign Minister Mohammad Ishaq Dar.

Guterres' last visit to Pakistan was in 2022, when he traveled to the country to assess the devastating flood situation.
